Variant of: Tsunami Arms Nekomata
Cost: 10,500eb (Super Luxury)
Class: EQ Sniper Rifle
Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Darkhound variant: a Barghest-modified version of the listed original. It ablates 1 extra SP whenever it would ablate armor. Ammo bought for it costs double, is one Price Category higher, and only fits the weapon it was bought for. Unless stated here, it keeps the original's rules.

Its Tech Rebuild shows rough target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover, and while charged it fires through one such layer. Extra ablation totals +1 SP uncharged and +2 SP charged, Darkhound bonus included.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog > Variants).
